top_signal.title: Should I go back to the boss that I don’t wanna work for?
top_signal.summary: I worked with a woman as a contractor and was making around $2500 a month. She has shouting problem and wanting to track me more than usual. So I had to let her go    I have solid experience but I’m not able to get contract work or clients to cover this amount. This amount was pretty important for me to cover up all my finances. I’ve been reaching out to busy bookkeeper and firms as well in case they need additional help but I wasn’t able to get anything.    Should I go back to her as I do have this option?  I’m severely stressed       submitted by     /u/AccountantShinobu       [link]       [comments]
